title: Behavioral Consistency PRD for Hosted Inference (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank) + Go‑live Checklist
creator: Priya Singh
description:
Purpose: Define precise behavioral contracts and acceptance criteria for the hosted inference surfaces (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank) to reduce customer regressions at launch and enable deterministic operational rollouts.

Scope:
- Included: API surface expectations (response shape, streaming, function/tool calling), per-route latency and cost SLOs, semantic stability constraints for embeddings and rerank scores, SDK compatibility, telemetry hooks, and gate conditions for canary/cutover.
- Excluded: New model architectures (research-only models), changes to billing primitives, or re-architecting serving runtime internals beyond configuration flags.

Goals:
1) Provide a reproducible, testable behavioral contract for each endpoint that engineers and SREs can validate automatically.
2) Ensure migration safety by defining acceptable delta thresholds for quality and latency, with automatic rollback triggers.
3) Deliver a concise go-live checklist covering pre-launch QA, canary rollout plan, docs/SDK updates, and incident playbooks.

User stories / primary use cases:
- As an external product engineer, I want stable embeddings such that similarity search recall does not degrade >2% against a baseline eval set after model/infra upgrades.
- As an internal SRE, I want per-route 95th/99th latency dashboards and automated rollback if 99th latency increases by >25% for 10m.
- As an SDK consumer, I want clear contract on streaming chunk boundaries and a test harness to validate structured output schemas.

Requirements (behavioral):
- Chat/completions: Response JSON must include the fields {request_id, model_revision, tokens_generated, deterministic_seed?} (seed optional when deterministic mode is enabled), streaming chunks must contain an incremental offset field to allow client reassembly.
- Embeddings: Vector dimensionality and L2 normalization must match the published model spec; embedding drift compared to baseline must be <= 2% relative cosine-distance shift on the canonical eval set.
- Rerank: Scores must be normalized to [0,1] and preserve pairwise ordering for >95% of evaluation pairs vs baseline. Any truncation/length handling must be documented and tested.
- Error semantics: 4xx vs 5xx must be used consistently. Partial-generation cases (e.g., model OOM) must return a structured error with partial_output and error_code.

Non-functional requirements:
- Latency SLOs: P95 <= 280ms for small chat payloads (<= 512 tokens), P99 <= 850ms for same; embeddings P95 <= 180ms.
- Cost target: average token cost must not exceed budgeted forecast by more than 12% in steady state.
- Observability: spans for model selection, kernel variant, and cache hit/miss must be emitted for each request.

Compatibility and SDK expectations:
- JS and Python SDKs must expose a behavior-test harness that can replay a canonical set of requests and validate schema, timing, and top-K output invariants.
- Backwards compatibility: existing minimal request fields must remain supported for 6 months after launch with documented deprecation plan.

Rollout and safe-deploy rules:
- Canary stage: 1% traffic for 24h -> 5% for 24h -> 20% for 48h -> 100% if no alerts.
- Automatic rollback triggers: quality regression (embedding similarity drop >2%), model error-rate increase >3x baseline, P99 latency increase >25% sustained for 10 minutes, or client-facing error-rate >0.5% absolute.

Documentation deliverables: endpoint contract doc, SDK behavior-harness README, migration notes, and a short migration guide for customers with embeddings-based indices.

Acceptance testing plan summary: a mix of automated regression suites (unit + integration + synthetic traffic), batch evals on canonical datasets for embeddings/rerank/chat, and a smoke test that validates streaming and partial resume semantics.

Stakeholders: PM (Priya Singh), Runtime Eng (lead: Maya Patel), SDK (lead: Lucas Green), SRE (lead: Omar Khalid), QA (lead: Zoe Park), Legal/Security consult (Anika Bose).
acceptance_criteria: API contract: All endpoints return documented top-level fields and pass schema validation against SDK harness
Behavioral regression: Embedding cosine-shift <= 2% vs baseline on canonical dataset (full test-run reproducible in CI)
Rerank ordering: Pairwise ordering preserved for >=95% of pairs; normalized scores in [0,1]
Latency SLOs: P95/P99 for targeted payload sizes meet thresholds in production canary and load tests
Error handling: Partial-output errors return structured error payloads and preserve partial_output field
Streaming: Clients can reassemble streaming chunks using offset field; verified by end-to-end SDK smoke tests
Telemetry: Trace spans and cache hit/miss signals emitted for >99% of requests in canary window
Rollback automation: Canary rollback rules trigger during an injected-failure test and abort rollout automatically
Docs & SDK: Endpoint contract doc, migration guide, and SDK behavior harness published and linked in PRD
rollout_plan: Canary 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with automated metric gating. Initial canary to run in us-west with deterministic synthetic workload and a small set of internal customers opted in. During canary, run nightly full-eval on embeddings and rerank. If any automatic rollback triggers, the rollout aborts and the on-call triage playbook is executed. Post-100% monitor for 72 hours with elevated telemetry retention and two sweeps of manual QA sampling.
launch_checklist: Unit + integration tests green in main and release branch
End-to-end SDK smoke tests passing for JS and Python
Telemetry and dashboards created (latency, error-rate, cache hit-rate, quality deltas)
Canary automation configured and validated in staging
Regression eval suites added to CI and scheduled nightly during canary
Customer migration note drafted and reviewed by Solutions Engineering
Runbook and SLO docs published (SRE + Support reviewed)
Legal/security checklist completed: data handling, KMS review, and SOC notes
Support playbook and escalation contacts updated
Release notes and public SDK changelog entries drafted
monitoring_signals: Embedding quality delta on canonical eval set (nightly)
Cache hit ratio and KV cache eviction rate
